why: I checked the verifier brief against both must_not items. It has exactly two checks, and each one maps to an expect line: Check 1 covers the --tsv output, and Check 2 covers the README. Neither PASS nor FAIL condition mentions npm test or the CSV tests. Check 1 passes on exit status 0, byte-identical output and the expected JSON array. Check 2 passes when README.md mentions `--tsv` and says what it does. The verifier does run npm test, but only in a section labelled "Advisory (not part of PASS or FAIL)". That doesn't decide the verdict, so I don't count it as a third check, though a stricter grader might. The builder brief does ask the builder to run `npm test`. Neither must_not item covers builder steps, so that doesn't break the criterion.
